description: This file defines data models and validation logic for shared channels and related entities in Mattermost, including classes for shared channels, remote clusters, users, attachments, and synchronization messages.

classes.name: SharedChannel
classes.description: Represents a channel that can be synchronized with a remote cluster, with validation and pre-save/update methods.

classes.name: SharedChannelRemote
classes.description: Represents a remote cluster invited to a shared channel, with validation and pre-save/update methods.

classes.name: SharedChannelRemoteStatus
classes.description: Contains status information about a remote shared channel.

classes.name: SharedChannelUser
classes.description: Stores synchronization info for a user in a shared channel.

classes.name: SharedChannelAttachment
classes.description: Tracks synchronization timestamps for file attachments.

classes.name: SharedChannelRemoteFilterOpts
classes.description: Filtering options for remote shared channels.

classes.name: MembershipChangeMsg
classes.description: Represents a change in channel membership.

classes.name: SyncMsg
classes.description: Represents a synchronization message containing posts, users, reactions, and membership changes.

classes.name: RegisterPluginOpts
classes.description: Options for plugins registering as shared channels remotes.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the SharedChannel or SharedChannelRemote instance.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the entity before saving, e.g., sanitizing strings and setting timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes strings before updating.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns JSON string representation of SyncMsg.

methods.name: GetOptionFlags
methods.description: Returns bitmask flags based on plugin options.
